title: An accessibility tree for a Dear ImGui app
blurb: Dear ImGui draws its own button, checkbox, slider and text field. Each one gets a real element inside the canvas that is never drawn and is placed with updateElementGeometry(), so the browser has a role, a name, a state and a box for it.
question: Can a canvas toolkit give each widget it draws a real DOM node that is never drawn, so that the accessibility tree, hit testing, Tab order and focus describe the toolkit's own widgets?
result: Yes in Chromium 157. The accessibility tree has the role, name, state and the bounds ImGui drew. A screen reader wasn't run.
